learning_outcomes.text: Evaluates the literary changes and developments of works in Turkish literature from the Tanzimat period to the present.
Interprets selected works from Turkish literature in terms of literary theories.
Examines the elements of literary genres.
Writes critical essays on the texts read.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the course content and resources
General information about the novel genre and its origins
Elements of the novel, narrative techniques
The emergence and development of the novel in Turkish literature
Short story in world and Turkish literature
